opportunities.name: Booking entry from forwarded email to confirmed TMS fields
opportunities.description: Extract booking fields from the forwarded quote chain for a person to confirm before entry; a working prototype already exists on one coordinator's machine.

opportunities.name: Completeness check on quotes before they reach the booking desk
opportunities.description: Roughly a third of bookings arrive missing something; a mechanical completeness check at handoff would cut the chase loop.

opportunities.name: Structured quote-to-booking handoff replacing the forwarded chain
opportunities.description: Agreed details scattered through email threads are re-derived by operations; a structured handoff carries them once. The CRM migration in flight should carry part of this.

opportunities.name: Quote assembly assisted from the rate cards, scoped read-only
opportunities.description: Quotes are built by hand from per-lane spreadsheets; the sales lead's stated condition is a scoped read of the actual rate cards only, with answers shown right before reliance.

opportunities.name: Tender fill assistance between the prospect's format and ours
opportunities.description: A large tender is two people copying for most of a week; assisted mapping frees the week for pricing judgement.

quantified.unit: person-days per major tender, self reported

opportunities.name: Status queries answered from the systems instead of the swivel chair
opportunities.description: About 60 queries a day each need the TMS, the carrier portal and the email thread; an assistant answering from the TMS directly needs the connector and verified answers.

quantified.unit: status queries per day, self reported

opportunities.name: Cut-off answers, verified and current
opportunities.description: The most-asked question failed as an assistant once because nothing checked its answers; the demand remains and the team's stated condition is answers shown right reliably.

opportunities.name: Escalations carried once, trackable end to end
opportunities.description: CS-to-operations escalations are retyped at both ends and untrackable once raised; a structured handoff with a status is the ask on both sides.

opportunities.name: A churn signal from query and volume patterns
opportunities.description: No number today says an account has gone cold; the signal would be derived from operating data once it has a governed home.

opportunities.name: The Monday margin pack generated from joined data
opportunities.description: A full day a week of hand-joining exports whose references do not match; generation from a governed join removes the day and the one-in-four error rate.

opportunities.name: Live data feeds behind the finance dashboards
opportunities.description: The deputy's assistant-built views work from hand-exported CSVs, stale on creation; live feeds are the stated want, with the finance lead's controls condition attached.

opportunities.name: Three-way reconciliation assisted
opportunities.description: The same shipment drifts across three systems; about 6 hours a week of matching is mechanical once the join exists.

opportunities.name: Month-end confirmations chased automatically
opportunities.description: Two to three days a month of shepherding desks to confirm jobs are closed; the chase is the same every month and mostly mechanical.

opportunities.name: Customs document pre-check when papers land at the booking desk
opportunities.description: The checks that bounce 1 declaration in 5 are mechanical and demonstrated live in session; the clerk's condition is reliability, because a wrong all-clear is worse than no check.

quantified.unit: minutes rework per bounced declaration, self reported

opportunities.name: The overnight rates pull moved off one analyst's laptop
opportunities.description: The official quotation process depends on an automation running under one person's logins that stops when he is away; it needs a service identity and an approved place to run.

opportunities.name: An inventory of where AI runs
opportunities.description: Embedded AI arrives by vendor update with no decision and no list; the note that governs the assistant cannot be applied to surfaces nobody has written down. Surfaced late in discovery and left ungraded.

opportunities.name: A recorded, lightweight approval path for tools and connectors
opportunities.description: Approval works today as an email with no record; a request a week is arriving and the record is what a client audit reads.

opportunities.name: The booking-entry prototype published through a governed route
opportunities.description: A working tool sits on one machine with no route to shared use, stopped partly by permission uncertainty; it is the natural first case for the publish route.

opportunities.name: Findability: structure the shared drive and index what is canonical
opportunities.description: The complaint the sponsor hears most; the cut-off spreadsheet answering the most-asked customer question is one instance. Company-wide, no single owning function recorded.

opportunities.name: Usage and spend visibility per team
opportunities.description: The console shows spend only; collecting what the current plan exposes turns the cost conversation into a value one before any tier decision.

opportunities.name: Carrier confirmations chased and recorded automatically
opportunities.description: Up-to-4-hour confirmation waits stall bookings and the customer often chases first; automated status capture into the TMS needs the connector and scoped permissions.

streams.name: Quote request to booked shipment
streams.statement: From a quote request landing in the sales inbox, through rate lookup, quoting and acceptance, to a booking confirmed in the TMS.

streams.name: Booking to delivered consignment and clean invoice
streams.statement: From a confirmed booking, through carrier confirmation, customs clearance and delivery, to an invoice that reconciles.

streams.name: Customer status query to answered customer
streams.statement: From a customer's where-is-it query, across the TMS, carrier portals and email, to an answer and any escalation resolved.

streams.name: Scattered exports to trusted weekly reporting
streams.statement: From figures spread across the TMS, the ledger and desk spreadsheets, through hand-joining, to the Monday pack pricing decisions rest on.
streams.end: Trusted margin pack with the sponsor

streams.name: Ad-hoc AI experiment to shared, trusted capability
streams.statement: From an individual's working experiment, through review and publication, to capability the whole company can rely on.

streams.name: Tender received to submitted RFQ response
streams.statement: From a prospect's tender spreadsheet, through rate assembly in their format, to a submitted response.

gaps.name: A governed, queryable home for operating data, reachable by approved AI
The TMS reachable read-only by the assistant, with permissions scoped per connection
gaps.owner: IT manager, once capacity is protected

gaps.name: A review-and-publish route from a staff-built tool to shared use
A shared verification pattern so an assistant's answers can be shown right before reliance
Service identity and an approved runtime for unattended automations
Protected learning time for the two-person IT team
